description: Kenya – Potential Grid Expansion Projects is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by World Bank Group. This dataset represents potential grid expansion projects identified through a least-cost geospatial analysis undertaken over the period 2017-2018. Each project (defined by the unique “gisprojec” or “project na”) includes electricity lines, poles, and building structures. Therefore, the dataset includes a combination of several feature types. Coverage: Kenya. It has 0 files. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
